lead.headline: U.S. ends 12-year Iraq mission as last coalition forces leave Erbil
lead.dek: Pentagon says Iraqi forces now carry primary responsibility; Baghdad declares a four-day holiday
body: The U.S. military declared an end to Operation Inherent Resolve in Iraq on Wednesday, saying all coalition forces and equipment had left Erbil Air Base under a 2024 agreement with Baghdad, closing the 12-year campaign against ISIS that began in 2014.

"The orderly departure of Coalition forces and equipment from Erbil Air Base marks the successful conclusion of the military mission that defeated ISIS in Iraq," Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell said. Roughly 2,000 Americans were in Iraq as of February, CBS News reported, and the roughly 1,500 troops in Syria withdrew earlier this year.

Parnell said Iraqi forces, including the Kurdish Peshmerga, now hold primary responsibility for ISIS remnants and Iran-aligned militias, with U.S. training and intelligence support continuing. Those militias launched more than 600 attacks on U.S. citizens and facilities between February and April, CBS reported. Iraq declared a four-day holiday, Rudaw reported.

briefs.headline: Hegseth to announce 20% cut to generals and admirals
briefs.summary: The defense secretary is set to unveil the cut Wednesday at Quantico, doubling last year's 10% order; 851 flag officers were serving as of July, CBS reported.

briefs.headline: Supreme Court lets third-country deportations resume
briefs.summary: Over the three liberal justices' dissent, the court blocked a 1st Circuit ruling requiring migrants a chance to object; arguments come in December.

briefs.headline: Consumer confidence falls to 12-year low in September
briefs.summary: The Conference Board index dropped 6.7 points to 81.8 from 88.6 in August; median inflation expectations for the next year rose to 5.1%.

briefs.headline: Boat carrying 62 migrants capsizes off Puerto Rico; 3 dead
briefs.summary: The Coast Guard said 49 people were rescued and 10 remain missing after the makeshift vessel overturned late Sunday near Mona Island.

briefs.headline: Iran receives U.S. answer on Hormuz plan; gap is over sequencing
briefs.summary: Spokeswoman Fatemeh Mohajerani told IRNA the response went to President Pezeshkian at Wednesday's cabinet meeting, CBS News reported; the Treasury sanctioned 10 suppliers of Iran's military.

briefs.headline: Russian strikes on Kyiv kill four, cut power supply
briefs.summary: Mayor Vitali Klitschko said a utility driver died when a warehouse was hit; DTEK said the grid was damaged and it restored power to 8,000 households.

briefs.headline: Morocco's king names Mansouri first woman prime minister
briefs.summary: King Mohammed VI tapped the 50-year-old Marrakech mayor and planning minister Tuesday, four days after her PAM party topped parliamentary elections.

briefs.headline: Seoul demands apology as North Korea denies DMZ mines
briefs.summary: Kim Yo Jong called Seoul's finding a 'conspiratorial farce' Wednesday; the UN Command said it found a live North Korean mine south of the demarcation line.

briefs.headline: Van residents press Boone board on school closure plan
briefs.summary: The Boone County board heard Tuesday from residents of Van on closing Van Elementary and sending high schoolers to Scott; a vote is set for Oct. 8.

briefs.headline: Sissonville shed-case children get $4.4M state settlement
briefs.summary: A Kanawha judge approved a $4.4M state settlement Tuesday for five children abused by their Sissonville adoptive parents, about $900,000 each.

briefs.headline: Clay County stabbing suspect found hiding in a dumpster
briefs.summary: Kanawha deputies arrested Kelcey Nicholas, 42, in Clendenin Tuesday after a resident found him in a dumpster; he is charged with malicious wounding.

briefs.headline: Fall fire season limits outdoor burning starting Oct. 1
briefs.summary: West Virginia's fall fire season begins Thursday, restricting outdoor burning to 5 p.m. to 7 a.m. through Dec. 31, the Division of Forestry said.

regional.item: Huntington City Council moved the gravel-lot and driveway parking ordinance to a second reading Monday and advanced a ban on engine brakes.
Putnam County commissioners adopted a resolution Tuesday saying data center developers must follow county ordinances as if HB 2014 did not exist.
A Wirt County grand jury indicted 17 people Monday on 117 counts, 97 of them felonies, including sexual abuse and child neglect charges.
Addison's council is creating an official record of the town's 1892 incorporation after the original charter could not be found, the Echo said Tuesday.

away.item: Bennington's Select Board and residents debated Monday how to spend an estimated $1.8M a year from a 1% option tax on the Nov. 3 ballot.

hotspots.item: The former Allegheny Wood Products mill in Cowen sold in pieces at a Sept. 17 auction, equipment and the 67-acre site going separately, the Echo said Tuesday.
Surf City posted a request Tuesday for a firm to run its public parking program, with enforcement and permits, proposals due Oct. 30 and a March 1 start.

briefs.headline: Prince George facilities plan puts 20-year cost near $900M
briefs.summary: An AECOM master plan for the city's 56 buildings flags eight for replacement, including Fire Hall No. 2 and Kopar Arena, and 11 for possible sale.

briefs.headline: Mr. PG wears orange ahead of reconciliation walk today
briefs.summary: The statue at Highways 16 and 97 got an orange shirt Tuesday from the Urban Indigenous Coalition and Lheidli T'enneh before today's Memorial Park walk.

briefs.headline: LNG Canada confirms $33B Phase 2 expansion in Kitimat
briefs.summary: The joint venture said Tuesday it will double output to 28 million tonnes a year; Carney, in Vancouver with Eby, cited up to 4,000 peak building jobs.

briefs.headline: Eby marks Truth and Reconciliation Day at Tk'emlups
briefs.summary: The NDP leader accepted an invitation to the reserve where masked men stood Sunday; First Nations leaders Tuesday asked Ottawa to outlaw denialism.

briefs.headline: Manitoba PCs name Narth interim leader after Khan quits
briefs.summary: Caucus unanimously chose La Verendrye MLA Konrad Narth on Tuesday, a day after Obby Khan quit as leader and left caucus to sit as an Independent.

briefs.headline: Watchdog says CSIS may have broken limits on lawbreaking
briefs.summary: The National Security and Intelligence Review Agency said Tuesday CSIS may not have complied with the law when using its power to commit offences.

briefs.headline: Forecast gives Crew-13 a 60% chance for Thursday launch
briefs.summary: The 45th Weather Squadron put favorable odds at 60% for Thursday's 11:10 a.m. ET liftoff from Cape Canaveral, NASA said Tuesday; cumulus cloud and rain rules are the concerns.

briefs.headline: Ten-minute X-ray flash traced to neutron star merger
briefs.summary: A Rome Tor Vergata-led team tied a July 2025 Einstein Probe burst lasting nearly 10 minutes to colliding neutron stars 6 billion light-years away, in Science Bulletin.

briefs.headline: Genome study traces first bats to Europe 65M years ago
briefs.summary: A 137-researcher consortium led from University College Dublin compared 103 bat genomes and 44 fossils in Nature and put bats' origin in Europe 65 to 60 million years ago.

briefs.headline: Low test scores in the 60s tied to 86% higher stroke risk
briefs.summary: Among nearly 5,000 Swedes followed 12.3 years, lower cognitive scores at ages 60-69 carried 86% higher stroke risk, Lund University researchers report in a heart association journal.

briefs.headline: Six AI companies sign voluntary White House accord
briefs.summary: Google, Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI, Nvidia and xAI signed a nonbinding four-layer pledge Tuesday covering monitoring, internal teams, outside auditors and board oversight; Trump called it 'morally binding.'

briefs.headline: White House opens America.gov chatbot run on Gemini and Grok
briefs.summary: The GSA-run portal, built by the National Design Studio, answers from 29,000 government sites; an order signed Tuesday makes it the entry point for services with 100,000-plus users.

briefs.headline: Nvidia agent-safety pact draws 100 firms, not OpenAI
briefs.summary: Nvidia's Open Agent Safety Platform, announced Monday with Anthropic and Microsoft among 100-plus partners, sandboxes agents; OpenAI stayed out but says it collaborates privately.
